title: Phase the Legacy parity candidate query
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Eliminate the remaining rank-2 Legacy candidate-query command timeout by separating its strategy-local preflight, legacy JSON binding scan, and main candidate selection into independently bounded commands without changing candidate membership, paging, ordering, or accounting behavior.
inScope: Change only GetHistoricalPaperFakFeeBackfillCandidatesAsync and its focused source-contract and PostgreSQL integration tests.

Run the strategy-local eligible LegacyUnknown fill-key preflight, the legacy PaperRun old_payload_json binding scan, and the remaining indexed candidate query as separate SELECT commands inside one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction.
Skip the legacy JSON scan when the strategy-local preflight returns no eligible fill keys.

Preserve PaperSellFill, exact PaperRun, legacy old-payload PaperRun, PaperPosition, and PaperSettlement parity exclusions exactly, including orphaned legacy PaperRun audit source IDs whose old payload binds a candidate order.

Preserve the existing 10-second command timeout on every phase, immutable cutoff, optional full tuple cursor, strategy/source/status filters, fallback and terminal-run guards, chronological order, page size and returned payload.

Run focused tests, a Release solution build, baseline-aware full-suite inventory, exact read-only Production phase preview, requirement validation, independent semantic review, task-only commits and push.
outOfScope: No database schema, index, migration, audit-row, strategy, order, fill, run, position, settlement, PnL, ROI, fee, configuration, timeout, worker scheduling, retry, or service-startup changes.
No Production writes, deployment, service stop, service restart, or log cleanup.
No change to Paper or Live execution behavior or to other historical-accounting phases and queries.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact Legacy Paper FAK candidate selection for one caller-supplied strategy visit, immutable cutoff and optional cursor; Production preview pins rank-2 strategy b7c50005-0001-4000-8166-000000000003 and cutoff 2026-08-07T22:44:55.219515Z.
scope.firstVerification: Use BEGIN READ ONLY and SET LOCAL statement_timeout='15s' against 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader to identify the physical plan and time the proposed phases for exact rank 2 without changing Production.

requirements.text: Доработать оставшийся нестабильный Legacy parity candidate query так, чтобы каждая тяжёлая фаза имела отдельный 10-секундный command budget и весь метод сохранял исходный единый read-only snapshot и точный результат.
acceptanceCriteria: A strategy-local preflight selects only the exact eligible LegacyUnknown fill/order keys under the existing cutoff and cursor predicates.
When the preflight is empty, no historical_gross_net_parity_audit legacy JSON scan is executed.
When the preflight is non-empty, a separate SELECT returns exactly the candidate order IDs bound by PaperRun AccountingDecision old_payload_json, with its own unchanged 10-second command timeout.

The main candidate SELECT excludes the preflight legacy-bound order IDs and retains the existing indexed PaperSellFill, exact PaperRun, PaperPosition and PaperSettlement exclusions, fallback/terminal guards, tuple ordering, limit and returned payload.
All phase commands execute on the same connection inside one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction so concurrent append-only audit activity cannot create a mixed-snapshot result.

Focused PostgreSQL tests prove that all existing parity binding shapes, including an orphaned legacy PaperRun source_id bound only by old_payload_json, still produce the identical candidate set and paging behavior.
No schema, index, timeout, configuration, worker, strategy, settlement, Paper execution, Live execution or Production mutation is present in the diff.

verification.expected: All focused source-contract and real-PostgreSQL integration tests pass, including unchanged inclusion/exclusion for every parity binding shape, no-scan empty preflight, one-snapshot phase wiring and full tuple paging.

verification.command: Run exact BEGIN READ ONLY, SET LOCAL statement_timeout='15s' Production phase previews for rank-2 strategy b7c50005-0001-4000-8166-000000000003 and cutoff 2026-08-07T22:44:55.219515Z.
verification.expected: Preflight, legacy JSON scan and main candidate selection each complete below the unchanged 10-second product command timeout and return the same two fill keys, one legacy-bound exclusion and one remaining candidate as the deployed semantics.
Release solution build succeeds with zero errors.

verification.command: Run dotnet test PolyCopyTrader.sln -c Release from the marked D:\CodexTemp run to inventory the repository baseline, then compare failing test names against the current known baseline and the three task files.
verification.expected: Every test exercising the changed method passes. Repository-wide failures are non-blocking only when their names and code paths are unchanged baseline failures outside the three task files; they are reported as failures and never represented as a green run.

verification.command: Independent reviewer compares the verbatim request and approved semantic digest against the actual task diff and all verification evidence.
verification.expected: Reviewer reports no scope drift, semantic regression, mixed-snapshot risk, or unsupported completion claim.

deviations.text: Use task-scoped non-regression rather than require the currently failing full repository suite to become green.
deviations.impact: All tests exercising the changed query and all focused real-PostgreSQL integration tests must pass, and the Release build must have zero errors. Existing full-suite failures outside the three task files remain visible and are neither fixed nor reported as passes by this task.
